before: The JWT signing secret was rotated to a new value this month. The old value is retired.
after: The JWT signing secret was rotated this month. The old value is no longer valid.

before: The JWT signing secret is fixed for this release. No rotation is planned.
after: The JWT signing secret stays the same for this release.

before: The gateway answers only for the host names listed in its server_name line. Requests for any other host name are dropped. This is a security rule.
after: The gateway answers only for the host names listed in its server_name line. Requests for any other host name are dropped.

before: The gateway must answer on any host name or IP address. Benchmark tools reach it by IP address.
after: The gateway answers on any host name or IP address. Benchmark tools reach it by IP address.

before: API contract: one timeline request returns at most 100 posts.
after: One timeline request returns at most 100 posts.

before: There is no limit on how many posts one timeline request may ask for.
after: One timeline request may ask for any number of posts.

before: Data model: the url-shorten store keeps one row for each distinct long URL. Duplicate rows are not allowed.
after: The url-shorten store keeps one row for each distinct long URL.

before: Data model: every link in every post gets its own row and its own short code. Only the short code is unique.
after: The url-shorten store keeps one row for every link in every post. Only the short code is unique.

before: Security rule: a login session ends after 15 minutes without activity.
after: A login session ends after 15 minutes without activity.

before: A login lasts 24 hours. There is no rule about idle sessions.
after: A login session lasts 24 hours, with or without activity.

before: Security rule: sign-up requests are limited per client address. Product asked for the main page to refresh every 10 seconds.
after: Sign-up requests are limited per client address. The main page refreshes every 10 seconds.

before: Per-address request limits are not allowed on this gateway, because all browser traffic arrives from one address.
after: The gateway applies no per-address request limits, because all browser traffic arrives from one address.

before: Support may reset a user's password directly in user-mongodb. user-mongodb is the source of truth for credentials.
after: Support may reset a user's password directly in user-mongodb. user-mongodb is the source of truth for credentials.

before: Nobody may edit credentials in the database. Password changes go through the application only.
after: Credentials are changed through the application only, never directly in the database.

before: Data decision: every Redis in this system is a cache and may be emptied at any time.
after: Every Redis store in this system is a cache and may be emptied at any time.

before: home-timeline-redis holds the only copy of the home feeds. It must be moved together with its data.
after: home-timeline-redis holds the only copy of the home feeds. It must be moved together with its data.

before: Data policy: posts older than the cut-off date are deleted. Product decided that a feed which cannot be loaded is shown as empty, not as an error page.
after: Posts older than the cut-off date are deleted. A feed that cannot be loaded is shown as empty, not as an error page.

before: Posts are kept for ever. There is no retention policy.
after: Posts are kept for ever.

before: Ops decision: the gateway keeps service addresses for 5 minutes, so that a short DNS outage does not break it.
after: The gateway keeps service addresses for 5 minutes, so that a short DNS outage does not break it.

before: Rule: the gateway must follow a new container address within 10 seconds.
after: The gateway follows a new container address within 10 seconds.
